ticket.subject: Users locked out after renewal
ticket.body_text:
Hi,

Our card on file expired, the renewal payment failed on Monday, and now three of our users see a 'subscription inactive' banner and cannot get into the workspace.

How do we update the card so they can work again? They are blocked right now.

Thanks,
Nikhil

label_notes: billing vs access: users are locked out, but the cause and the fix are a failed card payment, so billing; P2 because work is blocked with no workaround; high because users are blocked now.
